formation_submodel: FormationDynamics.initialize(gfg_prefix) -> formation_state; FormationDynamics.step(state, context) -> next_state; FormationDynamics.output(state) -> capability in [0,1]
stability_submodel: StabilityDynamics.initialize(gfg_prefix) -> stability_state; StabilityDynamics.step(state, context) -> next_state; StabilityDynamics.output(state) -> nonnegative degradation in [0,1]
initialize: CapabilityDynamicsMechanism.initialize(gfg_prefix) -> finite canonical JSON object containing formation_state and stability_state
intervention_apply: TrainingIntervention.apply(stage, context, state) -> finite canonical JSON state or null
post_formation_attribution: After capability formation, a predicted validation deficit below 0.90 must be produced by a positive StabilityDynamics degradation output; FormationDynamics must not hide the deficit by lowering its base capability below 0.90.
